implementation_observation.production: Server::drop calls try_wait, kill if necessary, and child.wait; success contributes to exit confirmation.
implementation_observation.windows_test: assert_reaped relies on a fresh sysinfo 0.37.2 CreateToolhelp32Snapshot lookup by PID without checking the occupant's creation identity.
implementation_observation.interpretation: The CI assertion alone does not distinguish a still-running original child, an exited-but-enumerated process, PID reuse, or wait failure.

second_independent_arm_experiment.snapshot_pid_identity_note: On a snapshot hit, probe would inspect occupant creation time to distinguish same process or PID reuse. No hits occurred in either arm; neither case was reproduced.

local_owned_process_probes.ownership: Each subprocess was created, terminated and waited by its own probe. No unrelated process was terminated or inspected by PID.
